G=load()
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(x for r in g for x in r),key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in g))
    b=[row[:] for row in g]
    # candidate rows: contain fg but don't touch right edge
    cand=[r for r in range(H) if any(x!=bg for x in g[r]) and g[r][W-1]==bg]
    best=max(cand,key=lambda r:max(c for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg))
    m=max(c for c in range(W) if g[best][c]!=bg)
    for c in range(m+1,W): b[best][c]=1
    return b
ok=all(solve(G[f'Demo pair {k} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {k} output'] for k in range(1,8))
print('all ok:',ok)
for k in range(1,8):
    print(k, solve(G[f'Demo pair {k} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {k} output'])
